messages:
incident-bot: Pager: P2 detected — elevated generation latency on /v1/generate in eu-west-1. 95th percentile jumped from ~2.3s to ~6.8s. Error rate for streaming clients ~1.8%. Link: https://ops.redwood.internal/incidents/2755554321
mike_oncall: Ack. I'm the on-call for eu-west. Starting triage now — pulling flame graphs and recent deploys.
sara_support: Noted. Support sees ~12 tickets mentioning slow responses; a couple of Dedicated customers reported timeouts. Marking potential customer-impacting.
emma_comm: I'll draft a short status page blurb. Do we have confirmed scope (hosted vs dedicated vs private)? Need that for copy.
alex_prod: Early signal points to a CPU amplification in the attention kernel when sequence lengths >2048 for a small subset of requests — looks like an encoder-only spike after a config change rolled 02:14 UTC. Reverting config in progress.
mike_oncall: Rolling config revert now on a small canary (2 instances) to verify. If stable, promote. ETA 8-12m.
incident-bot: Deploybot: revert-config job started by mike_oncall at 02:28 UTC. CI job id: #4578.
emma_comm: Draft statuspage copy (initial) — please sanity-check quickly: 
```
Initial: We are investigating elevated latency for text generation in eu-west-1. Some customers (including a subset of Dedicated customers) may experience slower responses or timeouts for generation requests. Our engineers are investigating and working on mitigation. We will provide updates every 30 minutes until resolved.```

emma_comm: Also propose short customer note for Support: "We're aware of slow responses from generation endpoints in eu-west-1. Engineers are investigating. If you're experiencing errors, please include request IDs and timestamps."
sara_support: That copy works. Add: "If you're on Dedicated and see persistent timeouts, open priority ticket and we'll escalate"
legal: Quick note — avoid saying "no data loss" until confirmed. Replace with "we have no evidence of data loss at this time."
emma_comm: Good catch @legal. Updated initial copy accordingly.
mike_oncall: Canary revert looks good — latency on canary back to baseline in 3m. Rolling revert to remaining eu-west pools now.
incident-bot: Rollout: revert-config promoted to 40% at 02:36 UTC by mike_oncall.
pagerduty-bot: On-call handoff reminder: if this persists beyond 1 hour escalate to oncall@redwood with SRE lead.
emma_comm: Publishing initial status page entry now (staged). Will not send customer email yet — waiting for rollback confirmation to avoid noise.
incident-bot: 30m update (02:58 UTC): Rollout at 100% complete. Observed 95th latency reduced to ~2.4s; streaming error rate down to 0.4%. Some Dedicated customers still seeing elevated tail latency intermittently.
alex_prod: Following revert we detected residual KV cache pressure on a minority of pods; applying garbage collection tweak to reduce memory churn.
sara_support: Notifying impacted Dedicated customers with targeted message; drafting support DM templates and escalation steps.
emma_comm: 60m public update draft: 
```
Update: The service is responding more quickly following a configuration rollback; latency has substantially improved for most customers. A small subset of Dedicated customers may still experience elevated tail latency while we apply additional mitigations. We continue to investigate and will post a further update in 30 minutes.```

legal: Reviewed. Language looks fine. Please ship.
mike_oncall: Applied GC tweak at 03:14 UTC to affected pods — monitoring.
incident-bot: 90m update (03:28 UTC): Error rates stable at baseline; tail latency for Dedicated customers trending down but not fully back to baseline (expect within 2 hours). No new regressions.
emma_comm: I'm drafting the resolved note but holding until Dedicated customers confirm. Proposed resolved blurb: 
```
Resolved: The issue impacting generation latency in eu-west-1 has been mitigated. Services have returned to normal operating parameters. If you continue to experience elevated latency, please contact Support and include request IDs. We are conducting a post-incident review to identify root cause and prevent recurrence.
```
sara_support: Two Dedicated customers confirmed normal behavior after 3:45 UTC. One remaining customer still reporting spikes — engineering reached out and adjusted routing for them.
alex_prod: We're going to keep a temporary route preference to the older model variant for high-seqlen requests for the next 6 hours while adding a regression test.
incident-bot: Final: issue marked RESOLVED at 04:00 UTC by mike_oncall. Postmortem scheduled on-call review tomorrow 16:00 UTC.
emma_comm: Published resolved status page entry and sent final closure note to impacted customers.
sara_support: Support follow-up templates sent; closing related support tickets after confirmation.
mike_oncall: Thanks team. I'll capture timeline and hand off notes into the incident doc (incidents/2755554321) for the full postmortem.
emma_comm: Good work all — clean, quick rollback. :tada:
